# CANDIDATE: VIX_RISING_REQUIRED_FOR_BEAR_ENTRIES

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring VIX > 20 and rising (current VIX > 5-minute prior VIX) for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries will improve trade quality by filtering low-VIX bearish setups that tend to fail. This targets the structural bias where bearish entries in complacent (low VIX) environments produce losers, while elevated/rising VIX confirms fear-driven moves suitable for ribbon rides.

## Mechanism

Entry filter: for side=='P' (put) entries, require (1) VIX > 20.0 AND (2) current VIX > VIX from 5 minutes ago. No changes to exit logic or other parameters. Applied in `evaluate_bearish_setup` after structural checks but before quality escalation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% risk cap limiting contracts to 3 at typical entry premiums.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest used 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with 1,240 bearish setup signals. Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** WF ratio=0.78 (OOS exp/tr=$41.20 vs IS exp/tr=$52.80) over 4.3-month held-out window (2026-02-19 to 2026-06-18).
4. **Real-fills:** Top-3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) show -$12/-$8/-$15 diff vs BS-sim (<5%), confirming fill quality; 5/05-5/07 losers avoided with zero slippage cost.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/11 (-$180 from whipsaw in rising VIX environment); max drawdown: -$1,850 (vs -$2,273 base); blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime (VIX<15) causing 0 entries and missed winners.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 32% of P&L (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/11, 5/18); base concentration was 41%.
